prompt.prompt: Generate an image: one game inventory icon in exactly the painted style of images 1 and 2: a single object, painterly and slightly gritty, strong readable silhouette, warm rim light, centred and filling most of the square frame with a little padding, on the same plain near-black background with no vignette pattern, no frame, no text, no letters, no numbers, no border. The object: a weathered upright stone tablet, its face carved with four ancient rune symbols in a row (a flame, a sun, a lightning bolt and a snowflake), the grooves worn and chipped, faint warm gold light in the deepest carved lines, grey-mauve dressed stone with an ochre crust of age.

Generate an image: one game inventory icon in exactly the painted style of images 1 and 2: a single object, painterly and slightly gritty, strong readable silhouette, warm rim light, centred and filling most of the square frame with a little padding, on the same plain near-black background with no vignette pattern, no frame, no text, no letters, no numbers, no border. The object: a broken fragment of carved stone, half grey-mauve dressed block and half raw gold-ochre sandstone, its face chiselled with one maker's mark: four small rune symbols (a flame, a sun, a lightning bolt and a snowflake) joined into a single round sigil, the sun rune still glowing a faint gold, cracks running through it.
